'''Doon Gorot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] weapon [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Gorot acted as a go-between for a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who was working for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and at some point during the conflict, Gorot traveled to a Separatist safe-house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], to meet with the Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Bandor Ootka]] and discussed the sale of a shipment of weapons to the Separatists.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
